heading: For review
description: Changes agents proposed instead of making them, and automations waiting for someone's approval. Approve a change to make it as you, edit it first, or dismiss it; approve an automation to let its run go on, or reject it to stop the run. Proposals no one answers expire after 30 days.
bulkSkipped: {count, plural, one {One change couldn’t be answered: it was answered already, its row changed since, or you can’t answer it.} other {# changes couldn’t be answered: they were answered already, their rows changed since, or you can’t answer them.}}

empty.decided: No changes were answered in the last 30 days.

proposes.createRow: <agent></agent> wants to add a row to <database></database>

title: Title
changedSince: Changed since it was proposed, now <value></value>
conflictNotice: This row changed since the agent proposed this. Approving overwrites what it has now.
failedNote: It was approved but couldn’t be made: {error} Edit it and approve it again, or dismiss it.

email.subject: Subject
email.reply: A reply to the row’s latest email

notEditable: Keep or leave out; change it on the row afterwards.

cannot.email: Only {name} can send this draft, from their own mailbox.
cannot.row: You can see this change, but approving it needs edit access to the row and to each value it sets.
cannot.approval: Only the people the automation asks can approve or reject this.

errors.notFound: This change is gone, or you can’t see it.
errors.conflict: The row changed since this was proposed. Look at it again, then approve it anyway or dismiss it.

banner.title: Changes waiting for review
banner.bar: {count, plural, one {# change waits for review} other {# changes wait for review}}

approval.nothingNext: If approved, the run ends: no steps come after this one.
approval.timeoutStop: If nobody answers in time, the run stops.
approval.timeoutContinue: If nobody answers in time, the run goes on.
